value.title: Слежение: цель — выбранная геометрия
value.meaning: Russian «Слежение» starts guidance to a copied selected geometry, not camera follow. The geometry/index is a snapshot; for lines/polygons the nearest planar facet point is recalculated for each eligible device fix, not automatically a centroid, first vertex or frozen nearest point.
value.value_origin: Selected overlay Feature.geometry first: ordinary ID selection loads full geometry, while Feature/Bundle/draft restoration can supply its stored snapshot. Full DB fallback runs only when null -> private GeoGeometry copy with restored CRS -> EPSG3857 JTS index -> nearest target facet per device lon/lat -> target point back to4326 -> inverse distance/true bearing -> controller/widget. Camera centre is not an origin or target source.
value.units: Source geometry EPSG4326 degrees or EPSG3857 projected XY; nearest facet choice uses3857. Reported range is metres from WGS84 ellipsoid inverse, with explicit spherical nonconvergence fallback; true initial bearing is clockwise degrees. Magnetic correction and camera-relative arrow are separate consumers.
updates: Selected feature action constructs the geometry snapshot/index once; eligible device fixes recalculate nearest point/result against that copy.
Database/FID/overlay changes are not themselves an updateTarget subscription. Freeze/follow/invalidate/notify behavior after such change remains a policy question in the existing canonical TODO.
actions: Enter Stakeout; stop/exit releases owned resources.
conditions: Selected supported Point/MultiPoint/Line/MultiLine/Polygon/MultiPolygon; constructor checks non-null/type,4326-or3857 and nonempty indexable WKT. Complete target-coordinate/topology/domain acceptance remains unverified.
Both shared portrait/land layouts bind the same panel and metre formatter for Lisa/Belka; no runtime resource-merge proof is inferred.
Polygon stakeout currently targets outer/inner boundaries even for an inside fix; an 'arrive anywhere inside' goal would be another explicit policy, not an inferred bug fix.
value.saved_state: Target holds private geometry/index, no layer/FID/workspace token. MapFragment saves mode plus selected layer/FID/geometry blob; same-process Boolean marker permits reconstructing guidance from that selected blob, while process death suppresses audible restart. This does not prove workspace/FID replacement safety or migrate live target/draft/account identity.
expectations: Independent source oracle: original geometry/CRS does not change when a target is constructed/calculated; nearest[0] is on indexed target, not current position.

Changing current device fix may move nearest point along the same line/polygon snapshot; panning camera cannot redefine geometry/origin. Range is not WebMercator planar length, and numeric magnetic azimuth remains separate from screen rotation.
Inside polygon has positive boundary range by current contract; a hole is a boundary. No centroid/containment-zero replacement is inferred.
A/B geometry/DB/Bundle controls must distinguish copied guidance target from current row and rendering. Accepted freeze/follow/invalidate policy must precede a product change.
Counterexample: isLocked hides layer controls but is not a ProjectOperationCoordinator DATA_SYNC lease or proof that sync cannot change data.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI/device/emulator/build/native resource merge acceptance in this proposal.
Constructor/copy/CRS and fallback branches are now manually pinned in source; all6-family runtime behavior, metric error envelope and invalid/global-coordinate cases remain unverified.
Existing AUDIT-TODO-NGW-REPLACE-FID owns source/DB/Bundle/workspace target replacement and expected freeze/follow/invalidate/notify behavior. No product bug or accepted migration policy is invented.
